Your coding agent shipped the feature in 10 minutes. Did it also ship a double-spend race condition?

> Install once and your coding agent stops rubber-stamping happy paths and starts hunting production outages like a principal SRE · **6 phases** · **7 domain playbooks** · **38 failure classes** · **adversarial disprover verification** · **zero npm dependencies**.

Quickstart · Before & After Proof · How It Compares · Scope · How It Works · Showcase · Supported Agents · Playbooks · Status

--- ## Quickstart Install in one command with zero runtime dependencies — drives your existing coding agent subscription: ### Universal (`skills.sh` — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill --skill chaos-audit # Or install globally across all projects npx skills add https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill --skill chaos-audit --global ```
Per-Platform Native Installs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity — macOS/Linux & Windows) #### Claude Code (`.claude-plugin/`) ```bash claude plugin install chaos-audit --marketplace Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill ``` #### Gemini CLI (`gemini-extension.json`) ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill ``` #### Cursor (`.cursor-plugin/`), Codex (`.codex-plugin/`), Google Antigravity (`plugin.json`) & Open Agents (`.agents/plugins/`) **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill.git mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -r chaos-audit-skill/skills/chaos-audit ~/.agents/skills/ ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill.git New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$HOME\.agents\skills" | Out-Null Copy-Item -Recurse -Force ".\chaos-audit-skill\skills\chaos-audit" "$HOME\.agents\skills\" ```
### Usage Load the skill and ask focused questions (**Guidance mode**, no artifacts written) or run a full codebase audit (**Full audit mode**, defaults output to `~/chaos-audit-skill//run-`): ```text Run a chaos audit on this codebase ``` ```text Hunt race conditions, duplicate webhook retries, and missing timeouts in ./src ``` ```text Do a reliability audit and output reports to ~/audits/my-service ``` --- ## Real Before & After Proof Every metric below separates **Skill Effectiveness (Blind A/B Eval)** from **Code Remediation Deltas (Real MIT Case Studies & Synthetic CI Fixture)**—measured via live local execution and controlled fault injection with zero fabricated numbers.

### 1. Blind A/B Skill Eval: `Without` vs. `With chaos-audit` ([Full Report](docs/EVAL.md) · [`skill-eval-ab.json`](examples/benchmark-results/skill-eval-ab.json)) Two fresh isolated agents running the **identical underlying model** audited an unseen, zero-comment Node.js service ([`examples/eval-suite/order-worker/`](examples/eval-suite/order-worker/server.js), `4` seeded bugs + `2` safely guarded decoys): | Metric | Control (`Without Skill`) | Treatment (`With chaos-audit`) | Observed Delta | |---|---:|---:|---:| | **Primary 4-Bug Recall & Safe-Guard Precision** | `4/4` (`100%`) · `0/2` FP | `4/4` (`100%`) · `0/2` FP | Honest baseline parity on obvious bugs | | **Total Confirmed Real Defects Proven** | `10` *(ad-hoc checks)* | **`17`** *(17x `3/3` failing tests)* | **`+70%` (`+7` deeper bugs caught)** | | **Formal `rejected` Guards & Falsified Claims** | `0` formal records | **`3` rejected + `3` disproved sub-claims** | Eliminates false-positive crash claims | | **CI-Ready `node --test` Suites (`3x` Repeat)** | `0` *(`1` hung script killed)* | **`20` suites (`60` clean runs)** | Reproducible regression gate | | **Ledger Coverage & Line-Bound Validation** | `0%` *(no schema gate)* | **`100%` (`16/16`) · `VALID` (`20/20`)** | Machine-verified traces & symbols | ### 2. Concurrent-By-Design MIT Case Study: [`coleifer/huey v3.5.4`](https://github.com/coleifer/huey) ([Full Case Study](docs/CASE-STUDY-HUEY.md) · [Audit Report](examples/case-study-huey/REPORT.md)) Audited untouched [`coleifer/huey`](https://github.com/coleifer/huey) (`6,066+` ★, MIT, commit [`7ea73730b9b6`](https://github.com/coleifer/huey/commit/7ea73730b9b6d413effdd67880970eb3e674974c)) with **zero mocks and zero artificial sleeps** against Huey's own explicit `FileStorage` exclusive-lock contract (`huey/storage.py:1384-1386`): | Scenario (`N=50` trials each) | Before (`huey v3.5.4`) | After (`LockedFileStorage`) | Raw Telemetry | |---|---|---|---| | **`FileStorage.peek_data()` vs. `pop_data()`** (`toctou_race`) | **`100.0%` (`50/50`)** · `444` exceptions | **`0.0%` (`0/50`)** · `0` exceptions | [`huey-case-study.json`](examples/benchmark-results/huey-case-study.json) | | **`FileStorage.enqueued_items()` vs. `dequeue()`** (`toctou_race`) | **`100.0%` (`50/50`)** · `1,468` exceptions | **`0.0%` (`0/50`)** · `0` exceptions | [`huey-case-study.json`](examples/benchmark-results/huey-case-study.json) | | **`FileStorage.result_items()` vs. `pop_data()`** (`toctou_race`) | **`90.0%` (`45/50`)** · `127` exceptions | **`0.0%` (`0/50`)** · `0` exceptions | [`huey-case-study.json`](examples/benchmark-results/huey-case-study.json) | | **Disprovers (`SqliteStorage.dequeue` / `MemoryStorage`)** | `0/50` dupes · `0/50` GIL `RuntimeError`s | **`2` candidates `rejected`** | [`findings.json`](examples/case-study-huey/findings.json) | ### 3. Synthetic CI Fixture (`vulnerable-checkout`) & Single-Process Durability (`tinydb v4.9.0`) - **Deterministic CI Regression Fixture ([`examples/vulnerable-checkout`](examples/vulnerable-checkout/benchmark.cjs) · [Full Report](docs/BENCHMARKS.md)):** Intentionally buggy synthetic fixture verified on every CI commit (`N=50`/scenario): `POST /checkout` double-spend `100%` (`-$4,000`) -> **`0.0%` (`$0`)**, `POST /webhooks/payment` duplicate credit `100%` (`+$2,500`) -> **`0.0%` (`$0`)**, and `GET /recommendations` blackhole hang `100%` (`50` leaked sockets) -> **`0.0%` (`504` fallback, `0` leaks, `p95=144 ms`)**. - **Single-Process File Durability Study: [`msiemens/tinydb v4.9.0`](https://github.com/msiemens/tinydb) ([Full Case Study](docs/CASE-STUDY.md) · [`tinydb-case-study.json`](examples/benchmark-results/tinydb-case-study.json)):** `tinydb` intentionally targets single-process workloads rather than multi-threaded writes; within that durability contract, simulated mid-write `ENOSPC` partial overwrites (`JSONStorage.write`) corrupted **`100.0%` (`50/50`)** of persisted DBs Before vs. **`0.0%` corruption (`100.0%` preserved)** After atomic temp-file swap (plus `100.0%`/`76.0%` -> **`0.0%`** under multi-threaded `insert()`/`upsert()`). --- ## Why This Exists & How It Compares AI-generated code almost always passes sequential unit tests with mocked 5ms dependencies — and then silently fails in production when two requests hit at the same millisecond, a webhook retries twice, or an upstream API hangs forever. `chaos-audit` turns reliability engineering from wishful code review into an **adversarial, evidence-gated loop** where every confirmed defect must fail deterministically in a real test. | Capability | Linters & Typecheckers | Security Audit Skills | UI Anti-Slop Skills | **`chaos-audit`** | |---|---|---|---|---| | **TOCTOU & double-spend races** (`SELECT` → `await` → `UPDATE`) | — | Partial | — | ✅ **Yes** (with parallel reproducers) | | **Non-idempotent webhooks & queue retries** | — | Partial | — | ✅ **Yes** (replay & out-of-order checks) | | **Missing HTTP timeouts, deadlocks & pool starvation** | — | — | — | ✅ **Yes** (DB, Redis, HTTP & sockets) | | **LLM tool duplicate calls & MCP `stdio` deadlocks** | — | Prompt injection only | — | ✅ **Yes** (dedicated agent-pipeline playbook) | | **Adversarial disprover + executed failure proof** | — | Security-focused | Visual checks only | ✅ **Yes** (`runs_failed >= 1` required) | | **Zero-dependency deterministic schema & line validator** | — | Security-focused | — | ✅ **Yes** (`validate-findings.cjs`) | --- ## Scope — What This Skill Is For, and What It Isn't ### In scope - Concurrency, race conditions, double-spend / lost updates, and `READ COMMITTED` write skew. - Duplicate webhook/queue redelivery, out-of-order events, lease expiry, and overlapping cron jobs. - Unbounded outbound HTTP calls, missing circuit breakers, cache stampedes, and pool starvation. - AI/LLM agent pipeline reliability: duplicate tool execution, runaway retry loops, partial-JSON corruption, and MCP `stdio` pipe deadlocks. - Frontend async state races (`AbortController`, double-submit, optimistic rollback corruption) and non-atomic disk persistence. ### Out of scope (deliberate — not gaps, design decisions) - **Live production chaos blasting:** Probes run strictly against local loopback/in-memory scratch copies; never against live URLs, payment gateways, or shared staging databases. - **Unverified severity inflation:** If a failure cannot be safely reproduced locally (e.g., kernel power-loss fault injection), it is strictly capped as `needs_validation` (`severity: null`). - **Security vulnerability hunting & UI styling:** Pair with `cloudflare/security-audit-skill` for AppSec and `impeccable`/`hallmark`/`unslop` for design. --- ## How the 6-Phase Pipeline Works

1. **Phase 1 — Reconnaissance ([`RECONNAISSANCE.md`](skills/chaos-audit/RECONNAISSANCE.md)):** Four parallel `research` agents map state stores, invariants, transactions, locks, webhooks, timeouts, LLM loops, and shutdown hooks into `architecture.md` and `fault-ledger.json`. 2. **Phase 2 — Coverage-Led Chaos Hunting ([`HUNTING.md`](skills/chaos-audit/HUNTING.md)):** Isolated hunters audit ledger units using `FAILURE-CLASSES.md` and relevant domain playbooks, followed by a Coverage Critic pass. 3. **Phase 3 — Adversarial Disprover & Live Reproducer ([`VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md`](skills/chaos-audit/VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md)):** A **fresh verifier** first tries to *disprove* each candidate by checking DB constraints, mutexes, and middleware guards. If unrefuted, it writes and executes a deterministic failing reproducer test in an isolated scratch directory. 4. **Phase 4 — Deterministic Schema Gate:** Parent validates `findings.json` via zero-dependency `validate-findings.cjs --repo-root --artifacts-root --ledger `. Any `confirmed` finding lacking `runs_failed >= 1`, `observed_failure_output`, real `file:line` bounds, or >=2 `source_trace` hops is mechanically rejected. 5. **Phase 5 — Independent Record Verification:** Fresh eyes re-verify cited source traces and reproducer exit outputs. 6. **Phase 6 — Target-Neutral Reporting:** Produces `REPORT.md`, `FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`, `REPRODUCERS.md`, and `NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`. ### Strict Three-Verdict Contract - **`confirmed`**: Verified broken invariant + complete `source_trace` + executed deterministic reproducer (`runs_failed >= 1`). - **`needs_validation`**: Source-grounded risk where safe local execution is blocked (e.g., kernel power-loss fault injection) — **`severity` is forced to `null`**, accompanied by an exact `safe_verification_recipe`. - **`rejected`**: Candidate disproved by an independent verifier citing the exact `mitigating_guard_location`.
What a Verified confirmed Finding Looks Like (from examples/sample-audit-output/findings.json) ```json { "verdict": "confirmed", "fingerprint": "fp-checkout-toctou-001", "fault_unit_ids": ["fu-checkout-wallet-001"], "title": "TOCTOU double-spend race in POST /checkout allows negative wallet balance", "failure_class": "toctou_race", "severity": "critical", "broken_invariant": "Wallet balance must never become negative and total debited orders must never exceed initial balance under concurrent requests.", "source_trace": [ { "file": "server.js", "line_start": 39, "line_end": 47, "symbol": "createVulnerableServer (/checkout check)", "role": "entrypoint" }, { "file": "server.js", "line_start": 49, "line_end": 52, "symbol": "createVulnerableServer (/checkout debit)", "role": "propagation" }, { "file": "store.js", "line_start": 42, "line_end": 49, "symbol": "FileCheckoutStore.setBalance", "role": "sink" } ], "reproducer": { "kind": "concurrent_test", "command": "node --test examples/vulnerable-checkout/reproducers/double-spend.repro.test.cjs", "test_file": "reproducers/double-spend.repro.test.cjs", "runs_executed": 3, "runs_failed": 3, "observed_failure_output": "Both concurrent POST /checkout ($80 each against $100 wallet) returned HTTP 200 OK; orders.length=2; final balance=-60." } } ``` See full output reports: [`REPORT.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/REPORT.md) · [`FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/FINDINGS-DETAIL.md) · [`REPRODUCERS.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/REPRODUCERS.md) · [`NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/NEEDS-VALIDATION.md)
--- ## Try the Runnable Proof Fixture This repository ships [`examples/vulnerable-checkout/`](examples/vulnerable-checkout/server.js) (a zero-dependency checkout & webhook service containing **4 intentional failure modes** — 3 live reproducible bugs + 1 blocked crash-safety check — plus **1 properly guarded `/refund` route**) alongside a complete validated run in [`examples/sample-audit-output/`](examples/sample-audit-output/REPORT.md): ```bash # 1. Run all 48 validator unit tests node --test skills/chaos-audit/validate-fault-ledger.test.cjs skills/chaos-audit/validate-findings.test.cjs # 2. Run live deterministic reproducers (fail against server.js, pass against fixed-server.js) node --test examples/vulnerable-checkout/reproducers/*.repro.test.cjs # 3. Validate the sample audit ledger & findings against real source files node skills/chaos-audit/validate-fault-ledger.cjs --repo-root examples/vulnerable-checkout examples/sample-audit-output/fault-ledger.json node skills/chaos-audit/validate-findings.cjs --repo-root examples/vulnerable-checkout --ledger examples/sample-audit-output/fault-ledger.json examples/sample-audit-output/findings.json # 4. Run the 50-trial Before vs. After chaos benchmark (~5s) node examples/vulnerable-checkout/benchmark.cjs --trials 50 --assert ``` See also: [`docs/EVAL.md`](docs/EVAL.md) · [`docs/CASE-STUDY-HUEY.md`](docs/CASE-STUDY-HUEY.md) · [`docs/BENCHMARKS.md`](docs/BENCHMARKS.md) · [`docs/CASE-STUDY.md`](docs/CASE-STUDY.md) · [`examples/case-study-huey/REPORT.md`](examples/case-study-huey/REPORT.md) · [`examples/case-study-audit/REPORT.md`](examples/case-study-audit/REPORT.md) --- ## Supported Agents & Native Manifests All native harnesses resolve to the single source of truth in [`skills/chaos-audit/`](skills/chaos-audit/SKILL.md): | Agent / Ecosystem | Manifest / Entrypoint | Discovery & Install | |---|---|---| | **Claude Code** | [`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`](.claude-plugin/marketplace.json), [`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`](.claude-plugin/plugin.json) | `claude plugin install chaos-audit --marketplace Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill` | | **OpenAI Codex** | [`.codex-plugin/plugin.json`](.codex-plugin/plugin.json), [`assets/icon.png`](assets/icon.png) | Native Codex plugin + `./skills/` | | **Cursor** | [`.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`](.cursor-plugin/plugin.json), [`.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`](.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json) | Native Cursor plugin + marketplace | | **Google Antigravity** | [`plugin.json`](plugin.json), [`assets/logo.svg`](assets/logo.svg) | Native Antigravity plugin with 3 starter prompts | | **Gemini CLI** | [`gemini-extension.json`](gemini-extension.json) | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill` | | **Universal (`skills.sh` / OpenCode)** | [`.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`](.agents/plugins/marketplace.json), [`skills/chaos-audit/SKILL.md`](skills/chaos-audit/SKILL.md) | `npx skills add https://github.com/Treamyracle/chaos-audit-skill --skill chaos-audit` | --- ## Safety & Requirements - **Requirements:** A coding agent supporting tool use and parallel subagents, plus **Node.js `>= 20`** for the zero-dependency validators (zero `npm install` needed). - **Read-Only Source Inspection:** Full audits never mutate tracked repository files and default to writing reports outside the repo (`~/chaos-audit-skill//run-`). - **Scratch & Loopback Isolation:** Reproducer tests run strictly in isolated scratch paths against local loopback/in-memory fixtures with zero outbound network calls and no production credentials. When a safe sandbox is unavailable, leads remain `needs_validation` (`severity: null`). --- ## Skill Playbooks & Validators 7 modular domain playbooks covering **38 failure classes**, paired with zero-dependency schemas and validators: | File | Classes | Purpose | |---|---:|---| | [`SKILL.md`](skills/chaos-audit/SKILL.md) | — | Operating modes, universal execution safety, 6-phase workflow, and anti-patterns | | [`RECONNAISSANCE.md`](skills/chaos-audit/RECONNAISSANCE.md) | — | Phase 1 parallel recon prompts and `fault-ledger.json` initialization | | Phases 3–6 adversarial disprovers, reproducers, and report templates | | [`FAILURE-CLASSES.md`](skills/chaos-audit/FAILURE-CLASSES.md) | 7 | Core TOCTOU, retry, lost-update, timeout, memory, and resource-leak checks | | [`DATABASE-AND-TRANSACTIONS.md`](skills/chaos-audit/DATABASE-AND-TRANSACTIONS.md) | 6 | Row locks, write skew, lock-ordering deadlocks, outbox, and pool starvation | | [`QUEUES-WEBHOOKS-AND-WORKERS.md`](skills/chaos-audit/QUEUES-WEBHOOKS-AND-WORKERS.md) | 6 | Duplicate webhooks, out-of-order events, lease expiry, DLQ loops, cron overlap | | [`HTTP-CACHING-AND-DISTRIBUTED.md`](skills/chaos-audit/HTTP-CACHING-AND-DISTRIBUTED.md) | 5 | Cache stampede, retry storms, fencing tokens, and monotonic clock checks | | [`STATE-AND-FRONTEND-CONCURRENCY.md`](skills/chaos-audit/STATE-AND-FRONTEND-CONCURRENCY.md) | 5 | Stale async races, double-submit, optimistic rollback, and multi-tab locks | | [`AI-AGENTS-AND-LLM-PIPELINES.md`](skills/chaos-audit/AI-AGENTS-AND-LLM-PIPELINES.md) | 5 | Duplicate LLM tool calls, runaway retry loops, partial JSON, MCP `stdio` deadlocks | | [`FILESYSTEM-IPC-AND-SHUTDOWN.md`](skills/chaos-audit/FILESYSTEM-IPC-AND-SHUTDOWN.md) | 4 | Non-atomic writes, lockfile races, `SIGTERM` draining, temp disk leaks | | [`validate-fault-ledger.cjs`](skills/chaos-audit/validate-fault-ledger.cjs) | — | Hardened zero-dep validator for `fault-ledger.json` ([tests](skills/chaos-audit/validate-fault-ledger.test.cjs)) | | Why This Exists & How It Compares AI-generated code almost always passes sequential unit tests with mocked 5ms dependencies — and then silently fails in production when two requests hit at the same millisecond, a webhook retries twice, or an upstream API hangs forever. `chaos-audit` turns reliability engineering from wishful code review into an **adversarial, evidence-gated loop** where every confirmed defect must fail deterministically in a real test. | Capability | Linters & Typecheckers | Security Audit Skills | UI Anti-Slop Skills | **`chaos-audit`** | |---|---|---|---|---| | **TOCTOU & double-spend races** (`SELECT` → `await` → `UPDATE`) | — | Partial | — | ✅ **Yes** (with parallel reproducers) | | **Non-idempotent webhooks & queue retries** | — | Partial | — | ✅ **Yes** (replay & out-of-order checks) | | **Missing HTTP timeouts, deadlocks & pool starvation** | — | — | — | ✅ **Yes** (DB, Redis, HTTP & sockets) | | **LLM tool duplicate calls & MCP `stdio` deadlocks** | — | Prompt injection only | — | ✅ **Yes** (dedicated agent-pipeline playbook) | | **Adversarial disprover + executed failure proof** | — | Security-focused | Visual checks only | ✅ **Yes** (`runs_failed >= 1` required) | | **Zero-dependency deterministic schema & line validator** | — | Security-focused | — | ✅ **Yes** (`validate-findings.cjs`) | --- ## Scope — What This Skill Is For, and What It Isn't ### In scope - Concurrency, race conditions, double-spend / lost updates, and `READ COMMITTED` write skew. - Duplicate webhook/queue redelivery, out-of-order events, lease expiry, and overlapping cron jobs. - Unbounded outbound HTTP calls, missing circuit breakers, cache stampedes, and pool starvation. - AI/LLM agent pipeline reliability: duplicate tool execution, runaway retry loops, partial-JSON corruption, and MCP `stdio` pipe deadlocks. - Frontend async state races (`AbortController`, double-submit, optimistic rollback corruption) and non-atomic disk persistence. ### Out of scope (deliberate — not gaps, design decisions) - **Live production chaos blasting:** Probes run strictly against local loopback/in-memory scratch copies; never against live URLs, payment gateways, or shared staging databases. - **Unverified severity inflation:** If a failure cannot be safely reproduced locally (e.g., kernel power-loss fault injection), it is strictly capped as `needs_validation` (`severity: null`). - **Security vulnerability hunting & UI styling:** Pair with `cloudflare/security-audit-skill` for AppSec and `impeccable`/`hallmark`/`unslop` for design. --- ## How the 6-Phase Pipeline Works

1. **Phase 1 — Reconnaissance ([`RECONNAISSANCE.md`](skills/chaos-audit/RECONNAISSANCE.md)):** Four parallel `research` agents map state stores, invariants, transactions, locks, webhooks, timeouts, LLM loops, and shutdown hooks into `architecture.md` and `fault-ledger.json`. 2. **Phase 2 — Coverage-Led Chaos Hunting ([`HUNTING.md`](skills/chaos-audit/HUNTING.md)):** Isolated hunters audit ledger units using `FAILURE-CLASSES.md` and relevant domain playbooks, followed by a Coverage Critic pass. 3. **Phase 3 — Adversarial Disprover & Live Reproducer ([`VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md`](skills/chaos-audit/VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md)):** A **fresh verifier** first tries to *disprove* each candidate by checking DB constraints, mutexes, and middleware guards. If unrefuted, it writes and executes a deterministic failing reproducer test in an isolated scratch directory. 4. **Phase 4 — Deterministic Schema Gate:** Parent validates `findings.json` via zero-dependency `validate-findings.cjs --repo-root --artifacts-root --ledger `. Any `confirmed` finding lacking `runs_failed >= 1`, `observed_failure_output`, real `file:line` bounds, or >=2 `source_trace` hops is mechanically rejected. 5. **Phase 5 — Independent Record Verification:** Fresh eyes re-verify cited source traces and reproducer exit outputs. 6. **Phase 6 — Target-Neutral Reporting:** Produces `REPORT.md`, `FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`, `REPRODUCERS.md`, and `NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`. ### Strict Three-Verdict Contract - **`confirmed`**: Verified broken invariant + complete `source_trace` + executed deterministic reproducer (`runs_failed >= 1`). - **`needs_validation`**: Source-grounded risk where safe local execution is blocked (e.g., kernel power-loss fault injection) — **`severity` is forced to `null`**, accompanied by an exact `safe_verification_recipe`. - **`rejected`**: Candidate disproved by an independent verifier citing the exact `mitigating_guard_location`.
What a Verified confirmed Finding Looks Like (from examples/sample-audit-output/findings.json) ```json { "verdict": "confirmed", "fingerprint": "fp-checkout-toctou-001", "fault_unit_ids": ["fu-checkout-wallet-001"], "title": "TOCTOU double-spend race in POST /checkout allows negative wallet balance", "failure_class": "toctou_race", "severity": "critical", "broken_invariant": "Wallet balance must never become negative and total debited orders must never exceed initial balance under concurrent requests.", "source_trace": [ { "file": "server.js", "line_start": 39, "line_end": 47, "symbol": "createVulnerableServer (/checkout check)", "role": "entrypoint" }, { "file": "server.js", "line_start": 49, "line_end": 52, "symbol": "createVulnerableServer (/checkout debit)", "role": "propagation" }, { "file": "store.js", "line_start": 42, "line_end": 49, "symbol": "FileCheckoutStore.setBalance", "role": "sink" } ], "reproducer": { "kind": "concurrent_test", "command": "node --test examples/vulnerable-checkout/reproducers/double-spend.repro.test.cjs", "test_file": "reproducers/double-spend.repro.test.cjs", "runs_executed": 3, "runs_failed": 3, "observed_failure_output": "Both concurrent POST /checkout ($80 each against $100 wallet) returned HTTP 200 OK; orders.length=2; final balance=-60." } } ``` See full output reports: [`REPORT.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/REPORT.md) · [`FINDINGS-DETAIL.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/FINDINGS-DETAIL.md) · [`REPRODUCERS.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/REPRODUCERS.md) · [`NEEDS-VALIDATION.md`](examples/sample-audit-output/NEEDS-VALIDATION.md)

**Scratch & Loopback Isolation:** Reproducer tests run strictly in isolated scratch paths against local loopback/in-memory fixtures with zero outbound network calls and no production credentials.
